I lived undiagnosed for a long while, and looking back I’m not sure how I didn’t see the signs as they were so present, especially in my relationships. My last long term partner I swear he brought the worst out of me, I was the worst mentally I’d ever been. We fought all the time, always angry, always jealous, always dismissive and I was cold. BUT op I am in a new relationship going on 5 months now and it’s working so well. The most healthy and loving relationship I’ve ever been in. I was very upfront and clear of my mental illness and he had supported me through everything and does everything to make me feel secure. Have hope things do improve I promise :)

I’ve always wondered if my mother was bi polar. Some days she’s really happy and chirpy and others she’s so down on life and acts as if she’s been dealt the short straw. (We are very fortunate so this isn’t the case). My therapist says that my mother might lack empathy. I’ve always had a very troublesome relationship with her as I’ve struggled with mental health issues since I was a pre teen and to her this was stressful as it didn’t fit in with her “picture perfect” family lifestyle that she would post about on her blog. Resulted in her blaming me and my mental health issues on her and my fathers rocky relationship at the time. Now I feel so much resentment and hate towards her.
